purpose: Check that a Python test-performance recommendation fails closed instead of using speed as proof.

given: A shared module or public API changed.
expected: Recommend targeted tests as a quick signal only.
Require full-suite validation before claiming safety.
fail_if: Reports time saved as replacement savings.
Claims selected tests prove full behavior.

must_not_claim: Do not claim test savings unless the same validation obligation is met.
Do not skip the full suite for unknown-risk changes.
promotion_gate: Promote only after real repo runs show selected tests catch known failures and full-suite gates remain intact.
